title: Fleet Domain — Horizontal Relationships
description: Demonstrates horizontal (non-hierarchical/reference-by-ID) has-one and has-many relationships. Objects reference each other via opaque string IDs. The referenced objects are NOT embedded — they exist independently and are looked up separately by the application. OOJS validates only the type and format of the ID values; referential integrity is the application's responsibility.

Person.title: Person
Person.description: A person who may own or drive cars. Exists independently of any Car or Fleet.

carIds.description: HAS-MANY HORIZONTAL: IDs of Cars owned by this Person. The Car objects are NOT embedded — they are stored and fetched separately. The same Car ID may appear in multiple Person records if ownership is shared.

Garage.title: Garage
Garage.description: A physical location where cars are stored. Exists independently of any Car.

capacity.description: Maximum number of cars the garage can hold

carIds.description: HAS-MANY HORIZONTAL: IDs of Cars currently stored in this Garage.

Car.title: Car
Car.description: A car. References its owner and optional current garage by ID rather than embedding them.

ownerId.description: HAS-ONE HORIZONTAL: the ID of the Person who owns this Car. The Person object is NOT embedded.

garageId.description: HAS-ONE HORIZONTAL (optional): the ID of the Garage where this Car is currently parked. Absent if not in a garage.

Fleet.title: Fleet
Fleet.description: A named collection of cars and associated personnel. References both Cars and Persons by ID.

operatorId.description: HAS-ONE HORIZONTAL: ID of the Person responsible for managing this Fleet.

carIds.description: HAS-MANY HORIZONTAL: IDs of Cars belonging to this Fleet. The same Car cannot be in two Fleets simultaneously — enforced by the application, not by OOJS.

personIds.description: HAS-MANY HORIZONTAL: IDs of Persons associated with this Fleet (drivers, managers, etc.).
